Pehli baat 🎂

Happy birthday to my dear bestest friend! 🎂💖

Aaj ka din tumhare life ka sabse accha, sabse best bane, yahi meri ichha hai. 🌟 Main hamesha tere liye pray karta hu ki bhagwaan meri is dost ko tu sab khushiyan dena, jo jo isko chahiye wo sab isko dena. 🙏✨

Bhagwaan, meri is dost ke life mein kabhi koi problem na aaye. Wo hamesha apni life ko khud ke according jeeye, use kabhi kisi pe dependent na rehna pade. Wo apne saare sapne poore kare aur apni life mein bahut bahut bahut aage jaaye. 🌈✈️

Wo hamesha khush rahe, hamesha muskuraati rahe, bina kisi tension. 😊 Saath hi uski jitni bhi beemariyan hain, wo theek ho jaaye, meri bhagwaan se bas yahi pray hai. 🤍

Tu jahan bhi rahe, jaise bhi rahe, khush rahe. Apni life ko khul kar jeeyo, kabhi kisi ke aage jhukna nahi, kabhi kisi se darna nahi. 💪🦋

Dusri baat 💖

Pata hai kya, tum na mere life ki sabse sabse sabse best yaadon aur best moments mein hamesha rahogi. 💫 Tumhare saath bitaaye huye har ek pal mere life mein hamesha rahega, tumhari har ek baat, tumhari har ek muskaan mere dimaag mein fit hai. 😊

Pata hai, tum meri ab tak ki sabse best aur sabse achhi dost ho aur hamesha rahogi. No one can take your place from my life. 💖

Pata hai Saloni, hamesha se na mujhe lagta tha ki kisi se love karna means sirf usko kaise bhi karke paana hota hai, but I'm wrong. Now I realised ki saccha love ka matlab sirf kisi ko paana nahi hota, balki uske har samay mein uska saath dena hai, usko uski freedom dena hai, usko hamesha support karna hota hai, uski har problem mein uska saath dena hota hai, usko kabhi bhi dukhi nahi hone dena, uski har chhoti badi cheezon ka khayal rakhna hota hai. Aur ye sab maine tumse hi seekha hai. 🌷

Aur ek cheez main pure dil se bolna chahunga ki mujhe sach mein tumse LOVE hai. Lekin ye love tumhe kisi bhi tarah se paane, ya tum par apna hamesha haq jatane wala pyaar nahi hai, balki ab main hamesha tumhe khush rakhna chahta hu, jaise bhi ho tumhari madad karna chahta hu. Ab chahta hu ki tum apne dream ko jeeyo, tum apni life ko khul kar jeeyo, aur isme main hamesha tumhare saath khada rehna chahta hu, tumhare har sukh dukh mein saath rehna chahta hu, tumhari problem ko samajhna chahta hu. 🤍

Main bhi flow flow mein zyada kuch bol diya, ab kuch nahi bolunga, warna tumhe shayad thoda odd lage ya uncomfortable feel ho, isliye. 🙈

And at the last main bas yahi kahunga ki main apni life mein hamesha tumhara saath dena chahunga. Tumhe kabhi kisi galat haathon mein nahi jaane dunga, jab tak main hu. Lekin haan, iske liye tumhe bhi meri kuch baatein maanni padegi. 🤝 Bas yahi ki main hamesha tere saath khada rahunga. Yaad rakhna, jab bhi tujhe meri need lage, kahin bhi tumhe lage ki Pankaj se baat karni chahiye, wo kuch kar sakta hai, tu bina hichkichaye bol dena ya call kar lena. Mera number tere paas hoga hi, nahi hoga to ye likh le: 📞 7488572186. Main hamesha tere saath khada rahunga, chahe DOST BANKAR ya fir PATI BANKAR, chahe jaise bhi. 🫶

Bas yahi kehna tha, zyada kuch nahi. Aur haan, upar wali love wali baaton se aisa mat samajhna ki main tumhe force kar raha hu ya jabardasti tumhe mujhse love karne ke liye bol raha hu, aisa bilkul mat samajhna. Faisla hamesha tumhara rahega. ⚖️💛

Pata nahi kyu ye sab likhte time meri aankhon se aansu aa rahe hain, shayad tumse attachment hi itni gehri ho gayi hai. 🥹 Bas yahi tha, ab baaki cheezein aage hain, dekho. ✨

Aur haan, sun, zyada tension mat lena aur poori raat overthinking mat karne lagna, samjhi? Warna zyada tension legi to samajh jana, phir ek lagega zor ka kaan ke neeche. 😤👋 Samjhi, tension lene ka nahi, tension dene ka. Tu kabhi tension mat lena, main hu na tere saath, tab tak to nahi, ab chal jaldi se has de aur badi smile kar zor se, “heeee” karke. 😁 Good girl! 🤗

HAPPY BIRTHDAY, ENJOY YOUR DAY AND LIFE! 🎂🎉
